suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went green on the first try, no 2am rollback needed.
I'm thankful for the aircon kicking back on right as the group chat started complaining about the heat.
I'm grateful for finally finding the actual root cause of a bug instead of just patching the symptom again.
I'm thankful for teh tarik that isn't oversweetened for once.
I'm grateful for the kedai kopi uncle remembering my order after just two visits.
I'm thankful for a code review that taught me something instead of just nitpicking formatting.
I'm grateful for the rain starting right after I got home, not while I was stuck waiting for a Grab.
I'm thankful for a quiet house at 5am, just me and the kettle before everyone else is awake.
I'm grateful for my dad still asking about my work even though he doesn't understand half of what I actually do.
I'm thankful for a Friday that genuinely ends early for once.
I'm grateful for the azan drifting in through the window right when I needed a reason to put the phone down.
I'm thankful for a stranger holding the lift door at the LRT station when both my hands were full.
I'm grateful for closing out a sprint without a single emergency hotfix.
I'm thankful for my sister sending voice notes just to annoy me, it means she's thinking of me anyway.
I'm grateful for a payday that lines up with the credit card bill instead of landing three days after it.
